target_customer: Offices and businesses ordering catering for meetings, plus restaurants and caterers listing menus
problem: Finding and ordering office catering from local restaurants is slow and manual.
business_model: B2B catering marketplace; restaurants list with no startup or monthly fees

founders.name: Jay Panchal
education: Georgia Tech, Systems Engineering (per YC page)
founders.background_notes: Capital Factory partner and mentor per YC page

technical_complexity.rationale: A two sided ordering marketplace with restaurant menus, delivery zones and fees, standard web engineering.

defensibility.rationale: Catering ordering was copyable by other marketplaces; the only edge would be restaurant supply and local relationships.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: The company was absorbed by Bite Squad, a food delivery company, and now operates under that name per aggregator and news summaries.

market_need_then: Not independently sourced for 2016; the YC listing describes demand from offices wanting easier catering ordering.

branding.domain_note: goodybag.com was the company domain; it now redirects to a GoDaddy for-sale page (fetched 2026).

brand_strength.rationale: No press about the brand was found and the domain is now for sale, so no evidence of brand impact.

outcome_analysis: Goodybag went through YC in Winter 2016 as an office catering ordering marketplace in Austin and was later acquired by Bite Squad, which consolidated it with other food delivery startups. The acquisition date is unclear: CB Insights suggests October 2017 while the CEO's Capital Factory bio says he sold it in 2016. Price, investors and rounds are not public in any source that could be verified, so the quality of the outcome cannot be judged.
notes: Seedtable lists a $1.3M seed and CB Insights lists $1.46M over 5 rounds including Capital Factory and Central Texas Angel Network; both are aggregators with no dated primary source, so treated as unverified and not recorded as rounds. Built In Austin gives founding year 2010, which conflicts with YC. Competitor search returned only current review pages, no dated 2016 sources, so the list is empty. Company website is dead (domain for sale).
